name: search_sfx
description: @funny sound library search. Searches, best first: the built-in procedural sounds (whoosh, impact, chime, pop, riser, and the @funny kinds boom = vine boom, scratch = record scratch, bleep = censor tone, swish, ding = bell, glitch — ids sfx-proc-<kind>, no download), the curated CC0 seed pack, and every sound fetched before. Names match in English, Hinglish and Devanagari ("vine boom", "bruhhh", "dhamaka", "धमाका", "घंटी"). With `online: true` it also asks Freesound (CC0 only; needs the user's Freesound key in Settings), Openverse (keyless Creative Commons audio, much of it from Freesound) and Myinstants (meme sound names; user uploads of copyrighted audio, licence unknown — use only as a short commentary sting, prefer built-in or CC0). Every hit carries its id, licence, credit, duration, score and reasons. Read-only; any phase. Pick one and place it with place_sfx.

query.description: What the sound is, in any script: a name ("vine boom", "bruh", "sad violin"), a kind ("record scratch", "airhorn") or a Hinglish word ("dhamaka", "ghanti").

tags.description: Only sounds carrying at least one of these tags (e.g. ["meme"], ["transition"], ["censor"]). A tag-only search lists them.

online.description: Also search Freesound (with the user's key), Openverse and Myinstants (default false).

name: place_sfx
description: @funny: places one sound at `at` (timeline seconds) on the comp's SFX audio track (found or made), labelled audioType sfx, in one undo step, and returns its clipId. Give exactly one of: `kind` (a built-in: whoosh, impact, chime, pop, riser, boom, scratch, bleep, swish, ding, glitch), `id` (from search_sfx; a library sample is downloaded once, trimmed of silence, loudness-normalised to -16 LUFS and imported into the SFX bin), or `query` (picks the best local match, else searches online; Myinstants uploads are skipped unless allowCopyrighted). Default levels sit under the voice: built-ins by kind (boom -14 dB, whoosh/swish/ding -16, bleep/glitch -18, scratch -20), samples -14 dB (-10 for meme/voice sounds like "bruh"); pass `db` only for a deliberate hit. Timing: a meme sound lands on the punchline word's end (+0-150 ms); a whoosh or swish starts ~0.2-0.3 s before the cut or entry it leads into; a pop or ding on the frame a sticker or text appears. The same sound at most 3 times per video; 6-12 sounds a minute in high-energy stretches. For a bleep over a word, use roast_move bleep (it trims the tone to the word). Returns the licence and credit line for the description's credits.

at.description: Timeline seconds the sound starts on.

id.description: A library id from search_sfx (sfx-proc-<kind>, a seed id, fs-…, ov-…, mi-…).

query.description: Find and place the best match in one step (any script).

tags.description: With query: only sounds carrying one of these tags.

online.description: With query: search online when nothing local fits (default true).

allowCopyrighted.description: With query: allow a Myinstants upload (rights unknown). Default false.

db.description: Gain in dB (-60 to 6); defaults sit 10-20 dB under the voice.

note.description: What the sound marks, shown in the clip name (e.g. "punchline", "card lands").
